title: Spearow Can't Fly Far, But Its Cry Reaches Half a Mile
premise: A 0.3-meter Spearow cannot fly long distances, yet its cry can be heard over half a mile away.
audiencePromise: See how Spearow's short-range flight makes its half-mile danger cry far more surprising.
openLoop: Why would a bird that cannot fly far need a half-mile cry?
payoff: The cry is not just loud. Its echoing high call is a shared warning that danger is nearby.
engagementQuestion: Which helps Spearow more: fast patrols or warning cries?

voice.instructions: Use a sharp, urgent tone. Start on the contradiction, then widen the scale with each scene. Slow slightly on "half a mile." Make the final reveal feel like Spearow's cry has changed from noise into a message.

scenes.headline: CAN'T FLY FAR. CRY DOES.
scenes.narration: Spearow can't fly far. Its cry reaches a half-mile.
scenes.caption: SHORT FLIGHTS. HUGE SOUND RANGE.

scenes.headline: ONLY 0.3 METERS TALL
scenes.narration: Spearow stands only zero point three meters tall in total.
scenes.caption: A VERY SMALL BIRD ON A VERY BIG MAP

scenes.headline: NOT BUILT TO GO FAR
scenes.narration: Its short wings make flying high and far difficult.
scenes.caption: INEPT AT FLYING HIGH OR LONG DISTANCES

scenes.headline: THE CRY KEEPS GOING
scenes.narration: That cry can be heard over half a mile away.
scenes.caption: THE RIPPLE OUTRANGES THE TINY BIRD

scenes.headline: THE SOUND IS THE WARNING
scenes.narration: When its high cry echoes around, Spearow warn of danger.
scenes.caption: NOT JUST A LOUD CRY. A SHARED ALERT.

scenes.headline: PATROL OR WARNING?
scenes.narration: Which helps Spearow more: fast patrols or warning cries?
scenes.caption: SPEED AROUND THE TERRITORY OR SOUND THE ALERT?
